text: {"reasoning":"To analyze why EU refunds increased from June to July 2026, we query Commerce.refundAmount along with Commerce.orderCount for context, broken down by month and Commerce.refundReason, filtered specifically to the EU region.","query":{"measures":["Commerce.refundAmount","Commerce.orderCount"],"dimensions":["Commerce.refundReason"],"time_dimensions":[{"dimension":"Commerce.orderedAt","granularity":"month","date_range":["2026-06-01","2026-07-31"]}],"filters":[{"member":"Commerce.region","operator":"equals","values":["EU"]}]}}
